ticks.note: `RobotA` no longer reads `bGoes`. The dependency runs one way, from A's writes of `aGoes` to B's read, so there is no cycle.
Both want to go. A goes; B's trigger is evaluated after A's write, sees `aGoes`, and B waits.
A is through and clears `aGoes`. B reads it after that write, in the same tick, and goes.
Both are through: nothing else happens.
